title: argumentShapes v0_1 -- one objection, a different argument (V1, 2026-09-26)
description: Built from the variations design v0_1, section 3 (efilist design/variations/VARIATIONS_design_v0_1.md, md5 fcf6f6fe), as ruled on 2026-09-26 (R-V1..R-V6; canon v38.42 adversarial_map.variations_rulings_V0). A shape is the same objection argued from a different premise or move. In the corpus, argumentShapes is a TOP-LEVEL list on a node, beside objectionSubforms, and never under responses (the game embeds responses whole). The corpus carries class (a) shapes only (R-V2). This file is the contract; shape_validator_v0_1.py enforces it, and its self-test asserts that the validator's constants equal the ones below.

shape_id.description: <node-id>/<slug>. The node-id is the objection the shape belongs to, and must resolve in the pinned corpus. Unique across every file loaded together.

statement.description: The objection in this shape, in the objector's voice, written plain (one register: the game shows it in PLAIN and SCHOLAR). 30-70 words, ASCII, no standalone dash tokens.

differs_by.description: One sentence: the premise or move that makes this a different argument from the node's trigger, layman line and scholar line.

class.description: The map's class law. Required in a staging file. In anything bound for the corpus it may be absent (implied a) and, if present, must be a (R-V2): (b) goes to the regen queue, (d) to the map, (c) to the intake.

oneOf.description: A realWorldExamples instance_id whose attached_objections include this shape's node.

answered_by.description: Required non-empty for classes a and b (where the library answers the shape, well or badly). May be empty for c and d.

locus.description: <node-id>#<locus>. The locus is whatever map validator v0_6's locus_valid() accepts on that node: short, medium, long, diagnosis, and, existence-gated, archetypeVariants.<slot> and note.

anchor.description: At most 15 words, a verbatim substring of the text at that locus (F5: a routing names the answering sentence, not only its locus).

phase.description: The shape phase letter. S is new and disjoint from the map's PHASES (A, B1, B2, C, D, E, F, R, G).

description: A staging file (a fragment). The same shape object is what a corpus node carries in its top-level argumentShapes list.

source_corpus_md5.description: Whole-file md5 of the corpus the anchors are cut from. The validator reads the corpus at this md5 (pinned.py), never the working copy by default.

source_corpus_objections_md5.description: Optional; hard when declared. The objections-array digest (map validator v0_6's objections_digest).

bound_for.description: corpus: every shape must be class a (R-V2).

shape_coverage.description: REQUIRED and gated against THIS file (ccclxx): <nodes carrying at least one shape in this file>/<objections in the pinned corpus>.

x-caps.description: At most 3 shapes per node across every file loaded together (the pilot's cap, design section 4).
